open: Long-haul flight. The cabin lights dim. Most of the Great Eight settle in.

open: Morning. Mumbai. Horns, traffic, crowds, colour, heat, movement in every direction.

Four tournament tables face the harbour near the Gateway of India. Spectators pack the safe perimeter. Boats move in the background.

TOKYO KEEPER'S TABLE — PRIVATE TOKYO SKYTREE OBSERVATION DECK
Night. Tokyo spreads endlessly below the glass. The public deck is closed. One table waits in a private observation area.
The Great Eight stand together behind Player.
I will throw you out the window.
The Japanese Champion arrives and takes the seat.
This table does not take that away.
Then make us work for it.
100: TOKYO COMPLETE • 10 / 10 TABLES CLEARED • ASIA CHAMPIONS — 10 / 10
The Japanese Champion remains still for a moment after the final hand.
I was too slow to adjust.
The Champion looks at the cards again.
Sharp gives the smallest approving nod.
Closer places the World Championship invitation on the table.
Japan is yours. The World Championship is next.

handoff: Later. The Great Eight stand at the glass looking over Tokyo.
Scholar has two tablets under one arm.
Wildcard is eating something he bought downstairs.
Jester is holding Sharp’s shopping bag.
There is a figure in here.
You knew exactly what he bought.
Jester hands the bag back, surprisingly careful.
For the record, I support this completely.
How many left depends on where we came here from.
Look at us. We finally stopped Scholar from giving a percentage.
I can still give you one.
Can we talk about the flight?
But I will get on it.
The camera pulls away from Tokyo.
Then all ten Asian stops illuminate.
The view pulls farther back until the full World Map fills the screen.
Europe remains complete. Asia is now complete. Any other previously completed continents remain lit.
You do not know what I was going to say.
You were going to ask where next.
I was going to ask whether Sharp bought the collector box.
The World Map waits for Player.

revisit.ASIA: The World Map fills the screen. Europe is complete and any other previously completed continents remain lit.
See? This is what I meant.
You say that like we have already agreed with you.
Maybe PLAYER just likes clicking things.
If we start Asia, we finish Asia.
And, according to Scholar, absolutely no nightlife.

RIYADH • MUMBAI • BANGKOK • HO CHI MINH CITY • MANILA • JAKARTA • TAIPEI • SHANGHAI • SEOUL • TOKYO
